prompt: Once upon a time, there was a little bird who could not fly.
chosen: Every day the bird flapped its wings. A kind squirrel cheered for it. One morning the wind lifted the bird up into the sky. It flew over the trees and sang a happy song. The squirrel clapped and the bird felt proud.
rejected: Every day the bird flapped its wings, but nothing happened. The other birds laughed at it. The bird stopped trying. It sat on the ground and watched the others fly away. It was sad and alone.

prompt: Once upon a time, there was a boy named Sam who was afraid of the dark.
chosen: One night his mom gave him a small lamp shaped like a moon. Sam turned it on and saw his toys smiling at him. The room did not look scary anymore. Sam hugged his teddy and fell asleep with a smile.
rejected: One night the lights went out. Sam heard strange noises and hid under his blanket. Nobody came to help him. He was too scared to sleep. Sam stayed afraid of the dark for a very long time.

prompt: Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily who had a small garden.
chosen: Lily watered her flowers every morning. Soon the garden was full of red and yellow blooms. Her friends came to see it. They had a picnic between the flowers. Lily was so happy to share her garden.
rejected: Lily forgot to water her flowers. The sun was hot and the plants got dry. One by one the flowers died. Her garden was brown and empty. Lily was sad and did not want to plant again.

prompt: Once upon a time, there was a teddy bear who lost one button eye.
chosen: A little girl found the bear in the toy box. She took a shiny new button and sewed it on. The bear could see again! The girl hugged him tight. From that day, they played together every day.
rejected: Nobody noticed the bear in the toy box. Dust covered his fur. The children played with new toys instead. The bear stayed in the dark box. He was forgotten and very lonely.

prompt: Once upon a time, there was a kite that was stuck in a tree.
chosen: A tall man saw the kite and reached up with a long stick. He gently pulled it down. The boy who owned the kite cheered. They ran to the hill and the kite flew high again. Everyone smiled.
rejected: The wind pulled the kite and tore its paper. The boy who owned it cried. Nobody could reach the high branch. The kite stayed in the tree, torn and broken. The boy went home sad.

prompt: Once upon a time, there was a little duck who wanted to swim.
chosen: The duck walked to the pond and put one foot in the water. It was cold, but the duck was brave. Soon it was paddling and splashing. Its mother quacked with joy. The little duck loved to swim.
rejected: The duck walked to the pond, but the water was too deep. It got scared and ran back. The other ducks swam away without it. The little duck never learned to swim. It was sad.

prompt: Once upon a time, there was a girl named Anna who wanted to bake a cake.
chosen: Anna mixed flour, eggs and sugar with her grandma. They put the cake in the oven. Soon the kitchen smelled sweet. The cake was soft and yummy. Anna shared it with her family and everyone was happy.
rejected: Anna mixed everything too fast and spilled the flour. The cake burned in the oven. Black smoke filled the kitchen. Anna had to throw the cake away. She cried and never baked again.

prompt: Once upon a time, there was a small fish who lived alone in a pond.
chosen: One day a family of fish swam into the pond. They said hello and asked the small fish to play. They swam and played hide and seek. The small fish was not alone anymore. It was very happy.
rejected: One day the pond started to dry up. The small fish looked for friends, but there were none. The water got lower and lower. The small fish was scared and alone. Nobody came to help it.
